reviews.text:
We needed an exterior paint job for our 100-year-old Portland bungalow, and the work Portland Painting & Restoration did for us has left us over the moon. Their entire team was nothing short of exceptional.

Our project required difficult prep work, experience of correctly dealing with lead paint, undoing and repairing previously done poor craftsmanship, and taking the time, patience, and care to give our home the love it deserved to look its absolute best.

Comparing them with other companies we worked with is night and day. It was immediately apparent that they were better trained and accustomed to working on older Portland homes than anyone else. The amount of care and craft they put into the prep alone was exactly the attention to detail you'd want to see in a project like this. And the end result has left us so happy.

We have delighted in watching neighbors and strangers pass by and take pictures of our new paint job, and have loved chatting with them about the exceptional work that was done. Recommending Portland Painting & Restoration has been a no-brainer. All have agreed their work looks outstanding.

PPR's communication, transparency, deep knowledge, craftsmanship, skill, *pride in their work*—everything top to bottom—these are the professionals you are looking for. No question about it.

We had a wonderful experience working with Portland Painting & Restoration. They completely restored our exterior siding with a fresh new stain and also painted several interior walls. The quality of their work was excellent.

What really made the experience stand out, though, was the people. Alex, our Project Manager, and Lexi, our Project Coordinator, were absolute gems. They were responsive, organized, incredibly easy to work with, and genuinely cared about making sure everything went smoothly.

The team also went above and beyond by helping us coordinate other trusted trades for additional exterior and interior projects, which was such a huge help. That level of service is hard to find these days.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Portland Painting & Restoration and will absolutely be working with them again on future projects!

Best decision we've ever made for our home - going with the crew from Portland Painting & Restoration! Skilled, professional, personable, reliable. They coordinated carpentry work to remove multiple areas of dry rot, rebuild our front-stair railing to be more in line with our house's architecture, and renovate our aging back deck. They also connected us with a lovely color designer. We couldn't be more pleased!

Excellent team and top quality house painting. We had a full house painting as well as some dryrot deck repair. The team provided excellent deck repair, spent time on through paint prep (peeling off lifting paint, sanding, etc), careful overall house painting and meticulous fine detail work. The outcome is a beautifully painted home. I also appreciated that while there was a bit of accidental glass damage in the process, the team was quick with response and fair and efficient in remediation. Overall, I recommend Portland Painting and Restoration for good communication, fantastic carpentry repair, excellent quality painting work and a top notch team.  Thank you!!!
